title: Retired services don't get deleted. They get archived.
hook: Seven retired services, preserved as evidence instead of deleted.
thesis: When Happy Place retired seven offerings, the graph archived them as retired evidence instead of deleting them. Business history stays honest and queryable: what you used to offer, and when, is part of the record. A surprising, principled little story about treating a business as evidence with provenance.

verified: The graph preserves retired offerings as evidence instead of deleting them: 7 archived as retired evidence, 6 live services (graph data doc, via SYSTEMS.md section 5).
